statement: OpenPuck supplies calibration 0x02 (37 bytes including ID), pairing 0x12 (16), legacy MAC 0x81 (7), and firmware 0xa3 (49). Comments attribute sizes to Linux host drivers. Its callbacks return payload-only lengths; these must not be confused with UHID numbered framing.

applicability.scope: compatibility GET feature behavior; host-driver-derived source lineage
